summary: First full run. Backend: 17/17 pytest pass (auth, authz, start/submit, 422 validation, exact scoring formula/levels/overall/path/body_page vs independent calc, priorities=3 lowest, retake_excluding_previous with zero overlap and 24 unique sub-themes, cross-student isolation 404, progress PATCH persistence, admin items/activities/stats incl. suppression). AI narrative returned source='ai' (Claude) on all submissions. Frontend: landing->login, 4 demo cards, role guards (student /admin -> /dashboard, admin /dashboard -> /admin), full 24-question UI check-in (clicks + keys 1-5 + prev + submit -> report-generating -> /report/:id), all 11 report sections, ticks/mood/tracker/reflections persist after reload, copy-script copies to clipboard, PDF download (11 pages, 3.3MB), dashboard cards/history/day30, admin overview (suppressed with 1 student, chart once 3 students), items tab search/filter/count, activities tab, path-2 report shows counsellor-handover + body page. Mobile 390: no page-level horizontal scroll, but snapshot tiles overflow their card.

minor.issue: Race: status is checked before a 10-20s AI call and only set to completed after report insert, so two concurrent submits (double click / retry) can create two reports for one assessment. Atomically flip status (find_one_and_update in_progress->submitting) before calling the LLM.
No validation: moods values not range-checked (0-4), tracker/reflections are Any with no size limit. A mood value like 9 makes frontend BANDS[moods[d]].c throw and break the Track page.
Averages/path split are per check-in, not per student, so a student with many retakes dominates the cohort numbers; suppressed response still exposes exact check-in/student counts.
'resources' = top-2 non-priority areas even when they score 0 (Rohan all-0 report shows 'Your resources: Social, Identity'). Consider requiring a minimum score (e.g. >=50) or wording fallback.

ui_bugs.issue: RadarChart has fixed width 340 (non-responsive). On desktop the left label is clipped ('amily & Future'); on 390px mobile the 340px chart forces the grid column wider than the card so the 4 snapshot tiles overflow past the card's right edge.

issues: Unset day numbers (#94a3b8 on white, 10px) are very low contrast
'Needs care first' badge wraps to 2 lines and crowds the score in 2-col layout
Area filter is a native <select>, not the shadcn Select used elsewhere (cosmetic)

action_items: Make radar chart responsive (ResponsiveContainer or width bound to container, add margin so outer labels aren't clipped) and add min-w-0 to snapshot grid columns so tiles don't overflow on mobile
Guard submit against concurrent double submission (atomic status transition)
Validate ProgressIn (moods 0-4 with keys 0-13, ticks pattern r-d, string length caps) and guard frontend BANDS lookup
Optionally: compute admin cohort averages per student (latest report) and avoid labelling 0-score areas as 'resources'
critical_code_review_comments: server.py submit: non-atomic in_progress check + long LLM await -> duplicate reports possible
Sessions never expire and demo-login inserts a new session each call (unbounded sessions collection) - acceptable for mocked auth but note
Retake exclusion only excludes the most recent sitting; a 3rd sitting within 7 days may repeat items from the 1st (fine per spec, just noting)
PlanTrack TrackPage saves whole tracker/reflections objects on blur; concurrent PATCHes are last-write-wins but each field is separate so low risk

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows work; one responsive layout bug)

seed_data_creation: Created check-ins via API/UI: stu-ananya now has 2 completed reports (latest b8a1862d-... via UI with TEST tracker/reflection/tick/mood entries) and no in-progress; stu-rohan has 1 all-'Almost always' report (path 2, overall 0) and an in-progress check-in started by the mobile test. Admin cohort is now unsuppressed (3 students).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_equimind_api.py -n 0 -v (submits take ~5-15s each with AI). pytest.ini forces xdist; use -n 0 not -p no:xdist. Retake test relies on starting within 7 days of the previous completed sitting. Re-check radar/snapshot layout at 390px and 1920px.
